component: Menu browser-test environment and rights notification

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The follow-up adds mail.rights.override=true to the menu suite while changing the dialog width minimum. The actual notification predicate negates this preference, so true suppresses the about:rights bar before its version fallback. This isolates test setup from the dialog geometry change; neither the preference nor the width declaration proves the reported intermittent size failure is cured.
title: The new-folder follow-up suppresses the rights notice in menu tests
